title: The Pleroma Map: 8 Rungs x 3 Faces

faceNotes.Syzygy: the key cycle and its signed counts

rungs.name: Pair (Logic)
rungs.caption: Signed insertion, deletion, and bit toggle. Two copies cancel.
rungs.description: Add and remove items; toggle bits; sign-flip counts.

cells.name: Signed insertion and deletion
cells.description: 0 = (+1) + (-1): add any signed count to any key up to capacity K, remove exactly.
cells.evidence: Adding then removing a count zeroes every cell, on the default field and on three primes.

cells.name: Binary choice
cells.description: One of two arrangements (S_2): stores read even vs odd exact counts.
cells.evidence: Counts on two arrangements exact, held in superposition through the kernel identity and swap.

cells.name: Flag toggle via XOR
cells.description: Flip any subset of flag bits via XOR mask.
cells.evidence: Each of 15 masks toggled once matches a rebuilt toggled store, and twice is the identity. A kernel composed twice is the identity.

rungs.name: Identity (Sets)
rungs.caption: Lookup, one-hot categories, exact flag words at any load.
rungs.description: Positional encoding on cycles; one-hot categories; binary codes.

cells.name: Key on the cycle
cells.description: Positional encoding: key = one position on a finite cycle. Identity encoding equivalent to sinusoidal and rotary.
cells.evidence: Keys exact 30/30 at 16 keys, refused 30/30 at 17 and beyond.

cells.name: One-hot category
cells.description: One corner of the symmetric group (one arrangement picked out).
cells.evidence: Arrangement index round-trips exactly, and a one-item store reads as one-hot.

cells.name: Binary codes and Hamming retrieval
cells.description: Every flag word and its Hamming-distance neighbors.
cells.evidence: Flag counts exact at any load. Hamming retrieval exact.

rungs.name: Relation (Algebra)
rungs.caption: Bind: keys add, flags XOR, arrangements compose. All pairs in one pass.
rungs.description: Bind two stores (group convolution); read exact counts and shares; detect parity.

cells.name: Multiset composition via binding
cells.description: Keys add (mod key space); counts multiply. One block product per representation.
cells.api: Bind(other), TryKeys counts, Attend(...) syzygy read
cells.evidence: Bind equals the store of all pairs, 35/35 across 5 shapes (including continuous and self-bind). 715 multisets of three bindings exact. The three-face read is exact 192/192 on 3 fields.

cells.name: Arrangement composition
cells.description: Bind composes arrangements as permutation product (left store on left).
cells.evidence: Arrangement unbinding exact 1,000/1,000 in the store. Reversing the order changes the result in 5,800 of 10,000 cases.

cells.name: Parity: odd-occurrence XOR
cells.description: Bind XORs flags; reads parity of count via cos(pi n).
cells.api: Bind XORs, BitCounts(), FlagParity(), Attend(...) parity
cells.evidence: Bit counts and parity exact 12/12 on 3 fields. 256 parity classes exact.

rungs.name: Function (Transforms)
rungs.caption: Store as lookup table. Shifts as harmonics. Time-valued maps with opt-in TimeSpectrum.
rungs.description: Treat the store as a lookup table; apply weighted shifts in one pass; read tick histograms.

cells.name: Table and Fourier shift
cells.description: Store IS the harmonic transform. Bind with one-item store = shift every key and value at once.
cells.api: ShiftKeys(k), Bind with one-item store, TryItems lookup
cells.evidence: Bind with a one-item store is the whole-store shift: 20/20 (key shift, flag relabel, arrangement relabel and tick agree).

cells.name: One-to-one map and balance check
cells.description: Each key maps to one tick or a mix. Opt-in TimeSpectrum holds per-key tick histogram.
cells.evidence: Time spectrum exact 37/37 (3 fields, signed). One-tick-per-key maps 60/60. Composed time maps 18/18, with bijections undone by their inverse.

cells.name: Boolean function and Walsh spectrum
cells.description: Fourier analysis of any Boolean predicate over Z_2^m.
cells.evidence: Predicates exact 1,515/1,515. 1,024/1,024 parity functions read from one spectrum. Weighted predicates 30/30.

rungs.name: Symmetry (Automorphisms)
rungs.caption: ScaleKeys (permute or gather). Conjugate arrangements. Frobenius x^2 on GF(2).
rungs.description: Key permutation and gathering; arrangement conjugation; GF(2) bit squaring.

cells.name: Key permutation and gather
cells.description: h -> u h (mod N): unit permutes, non-unit gathers. Requires CompleteKeys band.
cells.evidence: Every unit of 225 permutes (120/120 on two fields). Every non-unit gathers (113/113).

cells.name: Conjugation of arrangements
cells.description: s -> sigma . s . sigma^-1 for any permutation sigma.
cells.evidence: All 24 x 24 left-right pairs on S_4 exact.

cells.name: GF(2) Frobenius: bit squaring
cells.description: b(x) -> b(x)^2 modulo an irreducible polynomial. Linear map on the flag cube.
cells.evidence: Exact 18/18 (default field, continuous, 3 primes). The eighth power is the identity on x^8+x^4+x^3+x^2+1.

rungs.name: Composition (Products, Codes)
rungs.caption: CRT pairing of key cycles. Linear bit maps. Hamming syndromes.
rungs.description: CRT of key cycles; linear bit maps; Hamming error-correcting codes.

cells.name: Chinese remainder theorem pairing
cells.description: Join two coprime key cycles Na and Nb into Na*Nb via CRT residues.
cells.evidence: Exact 12/12 (63 x 55 with a continuous part, and 9 x 25).

cells.name: Independence test
cells.description: Check whether joint counts equal the product of marginals (exact integer test).
cells.evidence: Independent stores report true 40/40, dependent ones false 40/40, and one added item breaks independence 40/40.

cells.name: Hamming syndromes
cells.description: Count per Hamming syndrome (m = 3, 7, or 15 bits).
cells.evidence: Exact 15/15. All 112 single errors of Hamming(7,4) located.

rungs.name: Turning (Dynamics)
rungs.caption: Tick (exact rotation). Diffuse (Markov mixing). LFSR (shift registers).
rungs.description: Time evolution (rotation and diffusion); linear recurrences over GF(2).

cells.name: Spiral on the time circle
cells.description: Rotate every item by n ticks exactly, and fade by r^n (continuous part).
cells.evidence: All 4,096 combinations of shift, diffusion and count modulo 16 exact.

cells.name: Diffusion: Markov mixing
cells.description: Each step, item stays with probability a/b or moves one tick. Composed via kernel powers.
cells.evidence: Exact expected counts over 600 diffusion steps.

cells.name: Shift-register cycles (Galois LFSR)
cells.description: b(x) -> x b(x) mod polynomial. Linear recurrence over GF(2).
cells.evidence: Exact 9/9 on 3 primes. Period 255 for x^8+x^4+x^3+x^2+1.

rungs.name: Circulation (Topology)
rungs.caption: Holonomy (winding). Current (Kolmogorov). Frustration (parity).
rungs.description: Loop holonomy (winding numbers); probability current; frustration (loop parity).

cells.name: Winding number around a loop
cells.description: Sum of offsets around a loop, modulo RelationModulus.
cells.evidence: Loop reads exact 2,176/2,176. Merged and subtracted stores 1,804/1,804.

cells.name: Steady-state current direction
cells.description: Sign of probability current around a loop (Kolmogorov reversibility test).
cells.evidence: Reversibility read exact 200/200. Perturbed loops detected 120/120.

cells.name: Frustration: loop parity
cells.description: Parity of the integer sum around a loop (product = -1 or +1).
cells.evidence: Every loop's frustration read exactly.

lid.name: The Read-Time Choice
lid.description: One operation that is not superposable by nature: a read-time choice made once on the stored data.

cell.name: Draw one value with probability count/total
cell.description: One exact integer draw landing on its cumulative count.
cell.evidence: Every draw in [0, total) lands on its value. Shares uniform on 4/4 views.
